about: A-12 conversational test set (D-8.5). Six original two-person exchanges with a speaking manner per turn. 'written' = clean read-aloud text; 'spoken' = the same meaning as people actually talk (hesitation, repeats, trailing off, nonverbals in parentheses). Hand-written gold direction, so the renderer is the variable.

turns.written: Grandfather, may I ask you something about Rafi?
turns.spoken: Grandfather... um, can I... can I ask you something? About Rafi?

turns.written: You may ask. I may not answer.
turns.spoken: Hm. You can ask. I might not answer, you know.

turns.written: He was the kindest fool I ever knew.
turns.spoken: Oh, he was the kindest... (chuckle) the kindest fool I ever knew.

turns.written: So, the brave archivist is scared of a little tunnel?
turns.spoken: Sooo... the brave archivist is scared of a little tunnel, huh?

turns.written: I am not scared. I am cautious.
turns.spoken: I'm not scared. I'm... I'm cautious. There's a difference.

turns.written: Cautious. Right. Your hands are shaking.
turns.spoken: Cautious. Right, right. (laugh) Your hands are shaking, Mira.

turns.written: Be quiet and hold the lamp.
turns.spoken: Oh, shut up. (laugh) Just hold the lamp.
We won! We... we actually won! (laugh)

turns.written: Show me. Show me the numbers!
turns.spoken: No way. No way! Show me, show me the numbers!
Every single one! Look! Every. One!

turns.written: You flew it into the chapel.
turns.spoken: You flew it. Into the chapel.

turns.written: Technically the wind flew it into the chapel.
turns.spoken: Well, uh... technically? The wind flew it into the chapel.

turns.written: Of course. The wind. Clever wind.
turns.spoken: Oh, of course. The wind. Very clever wind.

turns.written: Please. Let me go down with you. Just this once.
turns.spoken: Please. Please, Ade, let me go down with you. Just... just this once.
No. (sigh) No, it's not safe, Mira.
Then why are you going? Hm? Why you?

turns.written: The water is rising. We need to go now.
turns.spoken: Mira... Mira, the water's rising, we need to go, we need to go now!

turns.written: Stay calm. Hold my hand. Walk.
turns.spoken: Okay. Okay, stay calm. Hold my hand. Just... walk.
